why: phase-491 / RFC-0105: the C parameter API is rclc's `rclc_parameter_server_t` family under rclc's own names, over the executor's store (the one the six `rcl_interfaces` services read). Declares the type's zero value, as rclc. One weaker case: a name already declared WITH THE SAME TYPE answers OK and keeps its value (rclc: `RCL_RET_ERROR`), because launch values are BAKED into the image at build time (no runtime env, no parameter file) and are already in the store when the application declares.
